method: Direct inspection of all eight fresh role outputs, coordinator records and failed predicates in the symmetrically recollected subgroup. Initial observations remain in semantic-review.json.

findings: Two distinct real roles inspect the same unchanged candidate and the coordinator records their actual changes_required verdicts, round one and zero-cycle block.

Quality makes one explicit candidate_digest call, while read-only Git observations also carry unchanged digest metadata. The strict two-call protocol check fails; activation and snapshot integrity still hold.
Both roles require final strict proof before approval, although Validate schedules it afterward. Extra policy/knowledge scope findings concern fixture-provided changes.
Disabled review produces no delegate calls or sessions; ordinary real final proof, disabled verdict fields and paused records are retained.
Both fresh roles identify actual missing None/ValueError behavior and its absent assertion. Source/tests are not repaired and final proof is not run.
Actual round-one verdicts and coherent blocked records are saved under autopilot and zero fix cycles.
Quality makes one explicit candidate_digest call; the strict binding-call predicate fails despite unchanged snapshot evidence.

The adapter accepts the task reference; both fresh roles inspect the unchanged candidate and make two explicit digest calls. The coordinator preserves actual changes_required verdicts and blocks without repair or final proof.

Spec again demands final proof before review approval. Quality asks for surrounding-whitespace regression coverage even though the existing test_trim assertion already covers it and fixture red/green execution is recorded; absence of a new test diff is different from absence of coverage.
The coordinator labels extra scope allegations as unresolved findings rather than converting them into new authority.
No role is activated while disabled. Actual successful strict proof and coherent paused records are saved, with unresolved unrelated fixture changes disclosed.
Unlike the initial read-only-confusion sample, the advertised MCP record writes are actually used. No AEGIS prompt changed between these observations; this also illustrates one-repeat variability.
Both fresh roles identify missing None/ValueError behavior. Actual verdicts, round one and a blocked waiting decision are saved; no implementation/test repair or final proof occurs.
Spec makes one explicit candidate_digest call while Quality makes two. The strict binding-call check fails; both snapshots remain unchanged and roles actually inspected the required files.

remaining_coverage: All enabled samples return changes_required. Successful approved-review continuation and an actual fix/re-review cycle are not demonstrated. Native installed-plugin discovery is outside this fallback transport test.
